problem_stats.label: Spend Growth
problem_stats.subtitle: Year-over-year surge in creator budgets
problem_stats.description: Brands are pouring 50% more capital into creator sponsorships ($34B in 2026), yet 78% of partnership leads report declining reach-to-sales efficiency.

problem_stats.label: High Performers
problem_stats.subtitle: The trusted minority driving actual sales
problem_stats.description: Only 15% of sponsored partnerships drive measurable conversions. 85% of budget is lost on vanity reach where audiences tune out or time-skip ads.

problem_stats.label: Too Slow to React
problem_stats.subtitle: Average time from trend identification to brief
problem_stats.description: Cultural moments peak and saturate within 7 to 10 days. Traditional 9-step agency outreach takes 4 weeks, launching campaigns when the trend has already died.

steps.name: Trend scouting on TikTok & YouTube Search
steps.desc: Manually scrolling hashtags and checking Google Trends interest graphs.

steps.name: Creator discovery & spreadsheet logging
steps.desc: Logging 15 creators, follower counts, email addresses, and past sponsors.

steps.name: Vetting sponsored video comment sections
steps.desc: Manually reading 50 comments per video to see if audiences skipped the ad.

steps.name: Cold DM & Email outreach
steps.desc: Drafting personalized cold emails and finding management agencies.

steps.name: Waiting for replies & agency back-and-forth
steps.desc: Follow-ups, rate card requests, and schedule alignment.

steps.name: Manual brief drafting in Google Docs
steps.desc: Writing talking points, dos and don'ts, mood boards, and review windows.

steps.name: Legal redlines & contract negotiations
steps.desc: Exclusivity terms, usage rights, and payment milestone clauses.

steps.name: Content review and revision rounds
steps.desc: Reviewing draft cuts, audio edits, and brand disclosure compliance.

steps.name: Post-campaign manual reporting
steps.desc: Exporting affiliate codes, screenshotting views, and estimating sentiment.

steps.name: Opportunity Alert
steps.desc: Gemini listens to Search & YouTube velocity and surfaces ready-to-pitch matches.

steps.name: Audience Trust Scoring
steps.desc: Audience comment intent mix (purchase vs annoyance) pre-calculated from verified sponsor history.

steps.name: Two-Sided 1-Click Opt-in
steps.desc: Either brand or creator initiates; bilateral interest unlocks mutual campaign room.

steps.name: Gemini Instant Shared Brief
steps.desc: AI generates cultural context, authentic talking points, guardrails, and optimal post window.

steps.name: Activation & Deal Structuring
steps.desc: Algorithmic recommendation for paid_now, test_first, or small_test_bonus.

large_creator.name: Marcus Vance (Apex Fitness Hub)
large_creator.key_quote: "Sponsor timestamp at 3:15 guys, skip straight to 4:45 to get past the pitch."
large_creator.insight: Massive reach, but viewers actively resist the ad read. The high fee results in negative or break-even ROI.

mid_size_creator.name: Taylor K. (Taylor Runs)
mid_size_creator.key_quote: "Already ordered using your discount code! The hydration vest fits without bouncing at all."
mid_size_creator.insight: High community trust. Viewers treat recommendations as advice from a peer, generating 4.8x higher total orders at 1/6th the cost.
